request:
Create an enemy-mob-32 sprite named "Ashwheel Gremlin".

Creative brief
Name: Ashwheel Gremlin
Collection: Ashforge Remnants. Abandoned forge creatures and half-living constructs powered by coals, slag, chains, soot, and unstable furnace heat.
Core concept: A chaotic roller that creates circular projectile trails around obstacles.
Body and silhouette: Small long-armed creature mounted inside a single large iron wheel.
Signature features: Spiked wheel rim, soot goggles, and a glowing coal basket behind its seat.
Palette and materials: Rust brown, black iron, dirty beige, and ember red.
Movement personality: Reckless, energetic, and difficult to predict.
Attack concept: Accelerates in a curved route while dropping hot bolts at fixed intervals, forming a readable dotted trail.
Directional details: One wheel spike is missing at the upper-left portion of the rim.
Avoid: Modern motorcycle, comedic clown vehicle, excessive wheel rotation blur.
